Name: Droid Companions
Author: FoolishGent
Description:
This mod combines PeacefulEnd's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8626]Custom Companions[/url] with aedenthorn's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17746]Buff Framework[/url] to create Star Wars droid sidekicks that will follow you around, make cute droid chirps, and provide unique utility buffs. 

Droids are summoned by equipping rings that can be purchased from the Dwarf. They will teleport back to your side if they get stuck on objects or get too far away.

[u]Installation:
[/u]1. Download and install the required mods. 
2. Download this mod's .zip file.
3. Unpack the zip into the "Stardew Valley/Mods" folder created by SMAPI.
4. Run the game with SMAPI.
5. Buy yourself a droid.
